units.source_zh: 人们往往安于现状，谁会思量五十年一百年后的事情？

units.source_en: The realm is not yet at peace; some upheaval may still occur.”
units.source_zh: 现在还不太平，说不定还会发生变故。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “是。人们往往安于现状，谁会思量五十年一百年后的事情？现在还不太平，说不定还会发生变故。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Indeed.”

units.source_en: “Indeed.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Lord Katagiri, have you heard the saying, ‘When a petty man lives in idleness, there is no evil he will not do’?”

units.source_en: “Lord Katagiri, have you heard the saying, ‘When a petty man lives in idleness, there is no evil he will not do’?”
units.source_zh: “片桐大人听说过‘小人闲居为不善’这话吗？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “片桐大人听说过‘小人闲居为不善’这话吗？”

paragraphs.source_en: “To my shame, I have in fact been pondering those very words.”

units.source_en: “To my shame, I have in fact been pondering those very words.”
units.source_zh: “惭愧惭愧，实际上，我一直在思量这话。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “惭愧惭愧，实际上，我一直在思量这话。”

paragraphs.source_en: “It is truly a maxim worthy of deep reflection. The daimyo of our day are all fierce warriors, each capable of holding a pass against ten thousand men.”

units.source_en: “It is truly a maxim worthy of deep reflection.
units.source_zh: “这真是一句值得深思的名言。

units.source_en: The daimyo of our day are all fierce warriors, each capable of holding a pass against ten thousand men.”
units.source_zh: 现在的各路大名，都是一夫当关万夫莫开的猛将。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “这真是一句值得深思的名言。现在的各路大名，都是一夫当关万夫莫开的猛将。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Naturally.”

units.source_en: “Naturally.”
units.source_zh: “那是当然。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “那是当然。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Thus, in time of war they are able men—men of worth.”

units.source_en: “Thus, in time of war they are able men—men of worth.”
units.source_zh: “因而在打仗时，他们都是能人，是贤良。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “因而在打仗时，他们都是能人，是贤良。”

paragraphs.source_en: “I see.”

units.source_en: “I see.”

paragraphs.source_en: “But what of them outside warfare?”

units.source_en: “But what of them outside warfare?”
units.source_zh: “但是在战事以外呢？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “但是在战事以外呢？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Outside warfare?”

units.source_en: “Outside warfare?”
units.source_zh: “战事以外？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “战事以外？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes. They possess no learning, nor do they have a craftsman’s skill to make anything with their hands.”

units.source_en: “Yes.
They possess no learning, nor do they have a craftsman’s skill to make anything with their hands.”
units.source_zh: 他们既不懂学问，又不能像手艺人那般有做些物品的才能。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “是。他们既不懂学问，又不能像手艺人那般有做些物品的才能。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Ha! Lord Ōkubo, you say the most intriguing things—”

units.source_en: “Ha! Lord Ōkubo, you say the most intriguing things—”
units.source_zh: “呵，大久保大人的话真有意思——”

paragraphs.source_zh: “呵，大久保大人的话真有意思——”

paragraphs.source_en: “Indeed.”

units.source_en: “Indeed.”

paragraphs.source_en: His face grave, Katsumoto moved the food tray from his lap and said nothing.

units.source_zh: 且元一脸严肃把吃食从腿上挪开，无言。

paragraphs.source_en: The daimyo had already begun taking precautions against such things and discussing them in private.

units.source_en: The daimyo had already begun taking precautions against such things and discussing them in private.
units.source_zh: 这些事，大名已开始防范，私下议论纷纷。

paragraphs.source_zh: 这些事，大名已开始防范，私下议论纷纷。

paragraphs.source_en: Having been appointed Seii Taishōgun, Ieyasu was sending Princess Sen to Osaka as a hostage; before long he himself would return to Edo, and then a vast reconstruction would begin. Until now, Edo Castle had been merely the Tokugawa residence. But if it became the shogun’s seat, the strength of the entire realm would surely be brought to bear upon it. Now that the beacon fires of war had died away, it was only reasonable that, while levying taxes and dues upon their people, the lords should also be answerable to the shogunal house that safeguarded their domains.

units.source_en: Until now, Edo Castle had been merely the Tokugawa residence.
units.source_zh: 迄今为止，江户城都是德川的居城。

units.source_en: But if it became the shogun’s seat, the strength of the entire realm would surely be brought to bear upon it.
units.source_zh: 但若是变成将军居城，必倾天下之力。

units.source_en: Now that the beacon fires of war had died away, it was only reasonable that, while levying taxes and dues upon their people, the lords should also be answerable to the shogunal house that safeguarded their domains.
units.source_zh: 烽燧平息，在对百姓课税收赋的同时，领主还得对保障自己领地安全的将军家负责，这样才合情合理。

paragraphs.source_zh: 封了征夷大将军的家康把千姬送去大坂为质，自己不日便会回江户，紧接着便会大力改建。迄今为止，江户城都是德川的居城。但若是变成将军居城，必倾天下之力。烽燧平息，在对百姓课税收赋的同时，领主还得对保障自己领地安全的将军家负责，这样才合情合理。

paragraphs.source_en: Yet more frightening were the words: “Provoke them just enough; whenever you see a swelling, lance each one and squeeze out the pus—” Whether as a daimyo or as a Toyotomi retainer, Katsumoto found that notion deeply troubling.

units.source_zh: 但更可怕的乃是：“适当地激怒众人，若是看到肿块，便一个个弄破，挤出脓水——”不管是身为大名还是身为丰臣家臣，且元都对这话甚是担忧。

paragraphs.source_zh: 但更可怕的乃是：“适当地激怒众人，若是看到肿块，便一个个弄破，挤出脓水——”不管是身为大名还是身为丰臣家臣，且元都对这话甚是担忧。

paragraphs.source_en: In truth, Ieyasu already possessed the power to do this. As Seii Taishōgun, he now commanded the realm. The men of whom Ōkubo Chōan spoke knew that they no longer possessed the strength to contend with Ieyasu—but did they also realize that in fact they had already become his vassals? All that now bound them to the Toyotomi was obligation; to the shogun, they owed obedience.

units.source_en: In truth, Ieyasu already possessed the power to do this.

units.source_en: All that now bound them to the Toyotomi was obligation; to the shogun, they owed obedience.

paragraphs.source_zh: 实际上，家康已拥有这个实力。他已作为征夷大将军统领天下。大久保长安所说的那些人，即便知道自己在实力上已无法与家康抗衡，可是否也知道，自己实际上已成家康的家臣？他们如今对丰臣氏只剩下义理，对将军则必须服从。

paragraphs.source_en: Until this moment, Katagiri Katsumoto had viewed the matter far too simply. He had presumptuously imagined that, as the representative of the Toyotomi house, he could placate Ieyasu. Yet though he was a senior Toyotomi retainer, was he not also a daimyo and a warrior—and therefore, like the rest, a vassal of the shogun?

units.source_en: Until this moment, Katagiri Katsumoto had viewed the matter far too simply.
units.source_zh: 在此之前，片桐且元把问题看得太简单了。

units.source_en: He had presumptuously imagined that, as the representative of the Toyotomi house, he could placate Ieyasu.
units.source_zh: 他曾自负地以为，自己作为丰臣氏的代表，可对家康采取怀柔之法。

units.source_en: Yet though he was a senior Toyotomi retainer, was he not also a daimyo and a warrior—and therefore, like the rest, a vassal of the shogun?
units.source_zh: 然而，他作为丰臣重臣，同时也是一介大名、一介武士，不同样是将军的家臣吗？

paragraphs.source_zh: 在此之前，片桐且元把问题看得太简单了。他曾自负地以为，自己作为丰臣氏的代表，可对家康采取怀柔之法。然而，他作为丰臣重臣，同时也是一介大名、一介武士，不同样是将军的家臣吗？

paragraphs.source_en: Seen in that light, the marriage of Princess Sen and Hideyori took on an entirely different meaning. At the very least, Princess Sen could not be regarded as merely a hostage. Tokugawa Ieyasu, the Seii Taishōgun who held the power of life and death over the Toyotomi house, had sent Princess Sen to Osaka as an act of trust—Katsumoto became so lost in thought that he did not even know how he had made his way back to the Asano residence.

units.source_en: Seen in that light, the marriage of Princess Sen and Hideyori took on an entirely different meaning.
units.source_zh: 这样一想，千姬和秀赖的婚姻便有了完全不同的含义。

units.source_en: At the very least, Princess Sen could not be regarded as merely a hostage.
units.source_zh: 至少，不可认为千姬仅仅是人质。

units.source_en: Tokugawa Ieyasu, the Seii Taishōgun who held the power of life and death over the Toyotomi house, had sent Princess Sen to Osaka as an act of trust—Katsumoto became so lost in thought that he did not even know how he had made his way back to the Asano residence.
units.source_zh: 掌握着丰臣氏生杀予夺大权的征夷大将军德川家康，乃是出于信任，才把千姬送到大坂——且元沉浸在思虑当中，甚至不知是怎么回到浅野府邸的。

paragraphs.source_zh: 这样一想，千姬和秀赖的婚姻便有了完全不同的含义。至少，不可认为千姬仅仅是人质。掌握着丰臣氏生杀予夺大权的征夷大将军德川家康，乃是出于信任，才把千姬送到大坂——且元沉浸在思虑当中，甚至不知是怎么回到浅野府邸的。
